event: Wed 25 Nov 15:30 SAST: US October PCE inflation, durable goods and Q3 GDP. Wed 21:00 SAST: Fed Beige Book. Thu 26 Nov: Thanksgiving, US markets shut. Fed decision Wed 9 Dec.

bullets.title: Broke 3,600
bullets.text: The latest price found is Anadolu's 3,563.10, down about 2% on the day; no later quote or New York close was found, so the current price is UNVERIFIED.

bullets.title: Strong US data
bullets.text: US consumer confidence jumped to 103.3 from 91.9 at 17:00 SAST, far above the 92.4 expected, and gold fell through 3,600 after it.

bullets.title: Hike still expected
bullets.text: Markets price about 95% odds of a 25 bp Fed hike on 9 December, which keeps pressure on gold.

bullets.title: Dollar and yields
bullets.text: The dollar is near a 19-month high and the US 10-year yield was 4.92% on Monday, both bad for gold.

bullets.title: Morning rally failed
bullets.text: Gold was sold from 3,679 in Asia, so today's whole bounce has been given back.

bullets.title: Lows close by
bullets.text: Monday's low 3,539.80 and Friday's 14-month low 3,513.54 are the next floors below price.

bullets.title: PCE on Wednesday
bullets.text: PCE at 15:30 SAST Wednesday is the big test, and Thanksgiving on Thursday will thin trading.
